text: Hear the word of the Lord, Israelites,for the Lord has a disputewith the inhabitants of the land: [AA]There is no fidelity, no loyalty,no knowledge of God in the land.
Swearing, lying, murder,stealing and adultery break out; [2]bloodshed follows bloodshed. [AB]
Therefore the land dries up,and everything that dwells in it languishes:The beasts of the field,the birds of the air,and even the fish of the sea perish. [AC]
But let no one accuse, let no one rebuke;with you is my dispute, priest! [3]
You will stumble in the day,and the prophet will stumble with you at night;I will make an end of your mother. [4]
My people are ruined for lack of knowledge!Since you have rejected knowledge,I will reject you from serving as my priest;Since you have forgotten the law of your God,I will also forget your children.
The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against me,I will change their glory [5] into shame. [AD]
They feed on the sin of my people,and are greedy for their iniquity. [6]
Like people, like priest: [AE]I will punish them for their ways,and repay them for their deeds.
They will eat but not be satisfied, [AF]they will promote prostitution [7] but not increase,Because they have abandoned the Lord,devoting themselves
to prostitution.Aged wine and new winetake away understanding. [AG]
My people consult their piece of wood, [8]and their wand makes pronouncements for them,For the spirit of prostitution has led them astray;they prostitute themselves, forsaking their God.

On the mountaintops they offer sacrificeand on the hills they burn incense,Beneath oak and poplar and terebinth,because of their pleasant shade. [9]Therefore your daughters prostitute themselves,and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.

I will not punish your daughters for their prostitution,nor your daughters-in-law for their adultery,Because the men themselves consort with prostitutes,and with temple women [10] they offer sacrifice!Thus a people without understanding comes to ruin.
Though you prostitute yourself, Israel,do not let Judah become guilty!Do not come to Gilgal, [11]do not go up to Beth-aven, [AH]do not swear, "As the Lord lives!" [AI]
For like a stubborn cow,Israel is stubborn;Will the Lord now pasture them,like lambs in a broad meadow?
Ephraim [12] is bound to idols,let him alone!
t[13] When their drinking is over,they give themselves to prostitution; [AJ]they love shame more than their honor.
A wind [14] has bound them up in its wings; [AK]they shall be ashamed because of their altars. [AL]
